semantics.original_evidence: Karnaugh map columns a=0,1 and rows bc=00,01,11,10; only a=0 bc=00 has output 0.
semantics.cycles: No clock or latency specified; output follows inputs combinationally.
semantics.reset_initialization: No reset or state specified; no initialization requirement.

numeric.widths: All inputs and output are one bit.
numeric.operation: Boolean inclusive OR of a, b, c; no arithmetic or signed interpretation.

verification.oracle: Explicit truth table transcribed from original Karnaugh map, indexed by abc.
verification.coverage: All eight binary inputs in ascending and descending order, sampling after combinational settling.
verification.success: Print line beginning PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X/Z inputs is not specified by the binary Karnaugh map; development oracle checks binary inputs only.
